name: peacock
description: Navigate codebases with compact local graph queries instead of broad searches and file reads.

interface.shortDescription: Compact codebase graph queries for agents
interface.longDescription: Peacock builds a local index of files, symbols, imports, and calls so Codex can orient itself and load only the source relevant to a task.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository and show me the smallest relevant code slice.
Find every caller of this function and assess its blast radius.
